explanation: Keating–Snaith as stated in Connes (arXiv:2602.04022, §3.4.5): c_k = a_k f_k with f_k = ∏_{j=0}^{k−1} j!/(j+k)!. The statement asserts moment k ∼ a_k ∏_{j<k} j!/(j+k)! (log T)^{k²} for all k. As consistency checks, k = 1 gives a_1 = 1, f_1 = 1, and k = 2 gives a_2 = ∏(1 − p^{-2}) = 6/π², f_2 = 1/12, so c_2 = 1/(2π²), matching Ingham. Faithful.
